notes_list.title: Divisibility Benchmarks (2 to 11)
notes_list.basic_overview: • Rule for 3 & 9: Sum of digits must be divisible by 3 or 9. • Rule for 4 & 8: Last 2 digits (for 4) or last 3 digits (for 8) must be divisible. • Rule for 7: Remaining Number - $2 \times$ (Unit Digit). • Rule for 11: $\sum(\text{Odd positions}) - \sum(\text{Even positions}) = 0$ or multiple of 11.
notes_list.extra_info_content:
📝 Quick Example Check:
For 11: In 123456, (1+3+5) - (2+4+6) = 9 - 12 = -3 (Not divisible).
Remainder Core Concept:
If $\frac{x}{m} \rightarrow$ Remainder $1$, then $\frac{x^n}{m}$ will always yield a Remainder of $1^n = 1$.

notes_list.title: Unit Digit & Factors Counting
notes_list.basic_overview: • Unit Digit Calculation: Focus purely on the unit place digit and use cyclicity of 4 for powers. • Total Factors for $N = 2^x \times 3^y \times 5^z$ is calculated as $(x+1)(y+1)(z+1)$.
notes_list.extra_info_content:
🔥 Advanced Formulas:
• Total Number of Factors (where $n > 10$): $(x+1)(y+1)(z+1) - 10$
• Number of Even Factors: $x(y+1)(z+1)$
• Number of Odd Factors: $1 \times (y+1)(z+1)$
• Sum of Factors: $(2^0+2^1+...+2^x)(3^0+3^1+...+3^y)(5^0+5^1+...+5^z)$

notes_list.title: LCM/HCF of Fractions & Polynomials
notes_list.basic_overview:
• For Fractions $\frac{a}{b}, \frac{c}{d}, \frac{e}{f}$:
  $\text{HCF} = \frac{\text{HCF}(a,c,e)}{\text{LCM}(b,d,f)}$ and $\text{LCM} = \frac{\text{LCM}(a,c,e)}{\text{HCF}(b,d,f)}$.
• Product Rule: $x \times y = \text{LCM} \times \text{HCF}$.
notes_list.extra_info_content:
🏃 Circular Track Case Study:
If runners A, B, and C take 12s, 18s, and 24s respectively to complete a lap, they will meet together at the starting point after:
$\text{LCM}(12, 18, 24) = 72\text{ seconds}$.

notes_list.title: Continuous Replacement & Alligations
notes_list.basic_overview:
• When a quantity $x$ is repeatedly replaced $n$ times from total volume $N$:
  $$\text{Left Pure Liquid} = \text{Original Volume} \times \left(1 - \frac{x}{N}\right)^n$$
notes_list.extra_info_content:
🥛 Milk-Water Replacements Example:
If 2L of milk is taken out from 20L and replaced with water 3 times:
$\text{Left Milk} = 20 \times (1 - 2/20)^3 = 20 \times (9/10)^3 = 14.58\text{L}$.

notes_list.title: CI Equal Installment Architecture
notes_list.basic_overview:
• For a rate of $10\%$ ($1/10$):
  Year 1: Principal to Amount ratio is $10 : 11$.
  Year 2: Squaring both sides gives $100 : 121$.
  To equalize installments, multiply Year 1 by 11 $\rightarrow 110 : 121$. Total Principal = $110 + 100 = 210$.
notes_list.extra_info_content:
📈 Key Differences (SI vs CI):
• Difference for 2 Years: $d = \text{CI} - \text{SI} = P\left(\frac{R}{100}\right)^2$
• Difference for 3 Years: $d = P\left(\frac{R}{100}\right)^2 \times \left(\frac{300 + R}{100}\right)$

notes_list.title: Mean, Median, Mode & SD Relations
notes_list.extra_info_content:
📊 Formula Box:
• Range = Maximum Value - Minimum Value
• Variance = $\frac{\sum |\text{Mean} - x_i|^2}{n}$

notes_list.title: Vinculum Transformations
notes_list.basic_overview:
Vinculum represents negative digits inside a standard base notation.
• $5 - 7 = -2 \rightarrow \bar{2}$
• $-5 + 2 = -3 \rightarrow \bar{3}$
notes_list.extra_info_content:
🔢 Recurring Decimal Tricks:
$0.9\bar{87} = \frac{987 - 9}{990} = \frac{978}{990} = \frac{749}{990}$ (Subtract non-bar digits from total, divide by as many 9s as bar digits followed by 0s for non-bar decimal digits).
